svg.title: Excitation and inhibition shape membrane voltage
svg.desc: A clean conductance-based illustration. Excitation, inhibition, and leak contribute current to one membrane. Three constant-conductance cases have passive steady voltages of minus 65, minus 46.4, and minus 56.8 millivolts. The illustrative comparison threshold is minus 50 millivolts.

g.text: Excitation and inhibition shape membrane voltage
Three conductances contribute to one electrical state.
Leak conductance: 10 nS. Constant conductances; no action potentials or reset.
